```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

schools     <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits      <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
surveys     <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "surveys.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
issues      <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues_open.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
new_projects <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "new_projects.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
full_updates <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "full_updates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse survey dates
surveys <- surveys |> mutate(
  survey_date = parse_date_time(StartDate, orders = c("mdY HMS", "Ymd HMS", "mdY HM")),
  survey_date = as.Date(survey_date)
)

# Build JSON for JS-side filtering
visits_json <- visits |>
  mutate(
    slug = school_name |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |> str_remove("-$"),
    visit_date = as.character(visit_date)
  ) |>
  select(school_name, slug, visitor, visit_reason, activities, urgent_issues, visit_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

issues_json <- issues |>
  mutate(visit_date = as.character(visit_date)) |>
  select(school_name, urgent_issues, visit_date, visitor) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

projects_json <- new_projects |>
  mutate(project_date = as.character(project_date)) |>
  select(school_name, visitor, project_type, project_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

full_json <- full_updates |>
  mutate(update_date = as.character(update_date)) |>
  select(school_name, update_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

surveys_json <- surveys |>
  mutate(survey_date = as.character(survey_date)) |>
  select(school_name, survey_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

schools_json <- schools |>
  select(any_of(c("school_name", "Region", "EPI Start Year", "Latitude", "Longitude",
                  "MGR", "Non-Generating MGR", "Feminine Hygiene Kits", "Science Kits",
                  "Library", "Computer", "Construction Projects", "Boreholes",
                  "Solar Power", "Biofill Toilets", "Light a Village", "Starlink", "GROW Project",
                  "n_visits", "n_responses", "n_issues"))) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())
```

## School Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
schools_with_coords <- schools |>
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

leaflet(schools_with_coords) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", school_name, "</strong><br>",
      "Region: ", Region, "<br>",
      "EPI Start: ", `EPI Start Year`
    ),
    radius = 6,
    color = "#1C2B4A",
    fillColor = "#F5B800",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 2
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<script>\nconst ALL_VISITS = ', visits_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_ISSUES = ', issues_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_PROJECTS = ', projects_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_FULL = ', full_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_SURVEYS = ', surveys_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_SCHOOLS = ', schools_json,
  ';\n</script>'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat(r"--(
<script>
// Helper: filter array by date range
function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

// Main render function
function renderDashboard() {
  var start = document.getElementById('date-start').value;
  var end   = document.getElementById('date-end').value;

  // Filter data
  var visits   = ALL_VISITS.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.visit_date, start, end); });
  var issues   = ALL_ISSUES.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.visit_date, start, end); });
  var projects = ALL_PROJECTS.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.project_date, start, end); });
  var full     = ALL_FULL.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.update_date, start, end); });

  // Schools needing full updates (only count canonical schools)
  var schoolsWithFullUpdate = {};
  full.forEach(function(f) { if (f.school_name) schoolsWithFullUpdate[f.school_name] = true; });
  var nNeedUpdate = ALL_SCHOOLS.filter(function(s) {
    return !schoolsWithFullUpdate[s.school_name];
  }).length;

  // Stat cards
  document.getElementById('stat-projects').textContent  = projects.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-needs-update').textContent = nNeedUpdate;
  document.getElementById('stat-issues').textContent    = issues.length;

}

// Use window.onload to ensure all CDN scripts are loaded
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
  renderDashboard();

  document.getElementById('btn-apply-dates').addEventListener('click', renderDashboard);

  document.getElementById('btn-reset-dates').addEventListener('click', function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById('date-start').value = syYear + '-08-01';
    document.getElementById('date-end').value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    renderDashboard();
  });
});
</script>
)--")
```
